reason: Coherent native authentication requires protected source provenance, a positive existing-auth preflight and native effective configuration observations without credential copies or assumed exclusions.

cases.expected: Owned no-symlink0700/0755 homes are accepted without mode changes; wrong ownership, group/other write, symlink ancestor/leaf or unavailable metadata refuses without repair.

auth.json metadata and bounded config reads require regular current-UID no-follow single-link exact0600 files. Missing, special, linked, foreign or weaker files refuse; no credential contents are read or logged.
A positive supported no-access-ACL observation is required. Write grants, nontrivial access ACLs and inaccessible/unsupported inspection refuse; mode bits alone never establish ACL safety.
Deterministic swaps between no-follow open, fstat and final path recheck cannot redirect a credential/config read or keep an old home/source identity valid.
Changed bytes, inode, ownership, mode or declared source version refuse before the next native launch/submission/effect; no automatic re-seal or normal configuration rewrite occurs.

New or vanished config/profile/project/managed sources, expected-absent files appearing, incomplete enumeration and exceeded count/size limits refuse. Unknown MDM/cloud sources are not treated as absent.

A changed credential during read-only preflight refuses. After explicitly admitted native use, safe atomic native refresh remains coherent under the same home, with permissions revalidated and principal continuity required; no credential copy/hash is used.
The actual launcher environment has the exact whitelist and UID-derived USER. Caller API/OAuth/access-token/base-URL/workload/provider/profile variables cannot pass through or select another account.

The actual factory/controller path starts no forced-method host without a fresh positive scoped preflight. The status argv contains no forced restriction or login/account-change option; a boolean or historical receipt cannot substitute.

An owned real status fixture emits the exact reviewed stderr marker with empty stdout, exit0, unchanged credential metadata and confirmed whole-group stop. Only the safe enum/scope/source/command/accounting projection is issued.

API, absent, unknown, extra/malformed output and misleading ChatGPT substrings refuse even with exit0. Synthetic credential sentinels emitted by the fixture never appear in files, logs, receipts or exception text.

Timeout, resistant descendants, output overflow, failure or unknown owned-group observation denies forced launch and retains failure/ownership rather than releasing uncertain capacity or trying another authentication path.

Expired or replayed status receipts and mismatched attempt/worker/UID/home/config/executable/accounting bindings refuse. Source or credential mutation between status and forced launch invalidates the receipt.

Before status, incompatible/unknown declared auth or managed restrictions refuse. The launcher never introduces a potentially destructive forced-method/workspace restriction to discover whether the existing credentials match.

The sealed canonical High profile binds exact supported feature/tool/hook/MCP/plugin exclusions. Known per-ID MCP disables are explicit; empty tables, disabledPluginIds, mutable aliases and unsupported app-server ignore-user-config flags do not establish exclusion.

Actual production constructors and an owned authored protocol process require correlated config/read layers/origins and supported effective feature observations before thread/start. Missing effective booleans, request-only flags, stale or foreign replies cannot pass.

Actual null or an exact compatible configRequirements/read result is required. Missing/error/unknown sources, forced hooks/provider/auth changes and incompatible requirements refuse instead of weakening policy.

Complete paginated thread-scoped MCP inventory must match the expected empty foreign-server set. Repeated cursors, incomplete pages, tool errors, stale/null runtime observations or foreign thread identity cannot become an absence proof or grant model work.

Explicit actual thread instructionSources must match the sealed reviewed allowlist. Omitted/defaulted sources, foreign guidance and requested max-bytes0 alone cannot prove loaded-source exclusion or select a new role.

Config/layer/MCP/env/header fixtures with randomly named secret sentinels are projected before persistence. Only reviewed fields and source hashes remain; raw response digests are labelled distinctly from complete retained frames, while profile-change event sources remain unchanged.

A changed source or native account/config signal stops subsequent effects. Same authMode, cached method or replayed observation cannot prove current principal/config continuity; actual matching fresh reads are required outside effect locks.

The actual factory/gateway/controller/startup/supervisor constructors enforce all configuration/auth stages and the separate current native-tool conformance gate. Authored controls cannot mint actual host acceptance, worker_start or a model lease. managed.py callback semantics and original failed/live-unrun evidence stay intact.

scope: Mechanical metadata/process/protocol/composition controls only. No native account/thread/model operation or normal-home permission/config change is authorized.
